main.title: NVIDIA Q1 FY2027: EPS $2.39 Beats $1.75 Est., Revenue $81.6B Tops $78.80B — Data Center Hits $75.2B, +92% YoY
main.body: NVIDIA reported record Q1 FY2027 results on May 20, 2026. Total revenue: $81.615 billion (85% YoY, 20% QoQ), beating $78.80B consensus. GAAP diluted EPS: $2.39 (214% YoY). Non-GAAP EPS: $1.87 (140% YoY). GAAP gross margin: 74.9% (up from 60.5% YoY, driven by lower inventory reserves vs. prior year $4.5B H20 chip charge). GAAP net income: $58.3 billion (211% YoY). Operating cash flow: $50.3B. Free cash flow: $48.6B. Data Center: $75.246B (92% YoY) — Hyperscale $37.869B (115% YoY), ACIE (AI Cloud, Industrial, Enterprise) $37.377B (74% YoY). Zero H20/Hopper China shipments in quarter. Data Center compute: $60.4B (77% YoY). Networking: $14.8B (199% YoY). Edge Computing: $6.369B (29% YoY). Q2 FY2027 guidance: ~$91B (±2%), excludes all China DC compute. Gross margin guidance: 74.9% ±50bps. $80B new share repurchase authorization (no expiration); remaining $38.5B. Quarterly dividend raised from $0.01 to $0.25/share. CEO Jensen Huang: 'The buildout of AI factories — the largest infrastructure expansion in human history — is accelerating at extraordinary speed. Agentic AI has arrived, doing productive work, generating real value.' CFO Colette Kress confirmed Vera Rubin will ship Q3 FY2027, ramp in Q4. NVIDIA introduced new two-segment reporting: Data Center (Hyperscale + ACIE) and Edge Computing. New partnerships: Hyundai, Kia, BYD, Uber, Google Cloud, Marvell for autonomous driving and ecosystem. Blackwell drove ~70% of data center compute last quarter. Data centers >10MW globally doubled YoY, now >80 facilities.

main.title: Samsung narrowly avoids 18-day chip strike after last-minute wage deal with 48,000-worker union
main.body: Samsung Electronics narrowly avoided an 18-day strike at its South Korean chip facilities after reaching a last-minute wage agreement with its 48,000-member union on May 20, just hours before workers were scheduled to walk out. The labor union suspended the planned strike (May 21–June 7) to put the tentative deal to an internal vote, with voting scheduled for May 22–27. The dispute centered on performance bonuses: the union demanded Samsung allocate 15% of annual operating profit to bonuses and remove a 50% annual salary cap. Samsung resisted, citing differences in profitability across divisions. Escalation timeline: Negotiations broke down in February and March. A previous one-day strike involved over 40,000 workers and caused foundry output to 'fall sharply' during night shifts. Samsung had begun winding down production ahead of the threatened action. Economic impact: Analysts warned of potential daily losses around 1 trillion won if production halted, with broader economic risks in the tens of billions of dollars. The compromise: Samsung agreed to postpone implementation changes for loss-making divisions' bonus distribution for one year, while maintaining its core performance-reward principles. A newly formalized special compensation system for semiconductor divisions was also introduced. Next step: Union member approval remains uncertain — rejection could reinstate strike threats at a critical moment in the global AI chip supply chain.
main.keep_reason: 삼성전자 18일 총파업(5/21~6/7)을 90분 전 극적 합의로 회피 — 글로벌 AI 칩 공급망에 미친 잠재 영향(일 1조 원 손실 추정) 영문 1차 정리. 5/22~27 찬반투표 결과는 후속 모니터링 필요.

main.title: 엔비디아 1분기 실적 발표: 영업이익 147% 급증, 베라루빈 3분기 출하 확정
main.body: 엔비디아가 2027 회계연도 1분기(2026년 2~4월) 실적을 발표했다. 매출 816억 1500만 달러(약 122.3조원)로 전년 대비 85%, 전 분기 대비 약 19.8% 증가해 12분기 연속 매출 신기록을 달성했다. 영업이익(GAAP)은 535억 3600만 달러(약 80조 2200억 원)로 전년 대비 147% 급증했다. GAAP EPS는 2.39달러(YoY +214%). 총이익률은 74.9%. 데이터센터 부문: 752억 4600만 달러(YoY +92%). 하이퍼스케일 378억 6900만 달러(YoY +115%), ACIE 373억 7700만 달러(YoY +74%). 컴퓨팅 604억 달러, 네트워킹 148억 달러. 에지 컴퓨팅: 63억 6900만 달러(YoY +29%). 2분기 가이던스: 910억 달러(±2%), 중국 데이터센터 매출 제외. 총이익률 74.9%(±0.5%p). 젠슨 황 CEO는 '에이전트 AI가 도래했으며, 수십억 개의 에이전트가 등장할 것'이라며 베라 CPU의 새로운 2000억 달러 TAM을 언급했다. CFO 크레스는 베라 루빈 출하 Q3 시작, Q4 대규모 램프업, 2027년 1분기 대규모 매출 발생을 공식 확인했다. 이사회는 800억 달러 자사주 매입 프로그램을 승인, 분기 배당금을 0.01달러에서 0.25달러로 인상했다.

main.title: KOSPI Semiconductor Rally: Samsung +6%, SK Hynix +4% Premarket as Strike Averted and NVIDIA Beats
main.body: South Korea's KOSPI semiconductor stocks surged in premarket trading on May 21 as two major catalysts aligned. Samsung Electronics jumped 6.16% to 293,000 won and SK Hynix climbed 4.3% to 1.82 million won on Nextrade as of 8:05 AM KST. Catalyst 1 — Samsung strike resolution: Samsung Electronics management and union reached a provisional deal 90 minutes before the planned May 21 general strike, suspending the 18-day action (May 21-June 7). The deal introduces a new DS division special performance bonus system, maintaining core OPI principles while providing flexibility on loss-making divisions. Worker ratification vote: May 22-27. Catalyst 2 — NVIDIA Q1 earnings: Nvidia posted 12th consecutive quarterly revenue record at $81.62 billion (+85% YoY), beating $78.85B consensus. Q2 guidance of $91 billion exceeded Wall Street's $87 billion estimate. The combined catalyst resolved two of the largest Korean semiconductor market overhangs — Samsung labor risk and global AI demand uncertainty. The previous KOSPI closed at 7,208.95 (down 0.86%), with foreign investors selling for 10 consecutive sessions. Analysts project the Samsung valuation discount (Samsung +28.67% vs SK Hynix +49.66% over past month) will narrow as uncertainty resolves.
main.keep_reason: 삼성 파업 타결 + NVIDIA Q1 호실적이 한국 반도체주에 동시 반영되는 거시 구도 정리 — 외국인 10거래일 연속 매도 종료, KOSPI 7,053 지지 등 시장 임팩트 통합.

main.title: Jensen Huang says he's found a 'brand new' $200B market for Nvidia
main.body: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang identifies a brand-new $200 billion total addressable market in CPUs designed for agentic AI. The market centers on Vera, Nvidia's new purpose-built Arm-based CPU with 88 custom Olympus cores, designed for the orchestration and execution layer of AI agents. Huang explained that while GPUs handle the 'thinking' of AI models, agents primarily operate on CPUs to execute tasks. He projected the world will have 'billions of agents' each requiring CPU resources, similar to how humans use personal computers. Nvidia has already achieved 'nearly $20 billion' in standalone Vera CPU revenue visibility for this year. The Vera CPU delivers twice the efficiency and 50% faster performance than traditional rack-scale CPUs, with 1.2 TB/s memory bandwidth. Key hyperscaler customers include Alibaba Cloud, ByteDance, Meta, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, and CoreWeave. System makers Dell Technologies, HPE, Lenovo, Supermicro are building Vera-based systems. The CPU is now in production, with partner availability in H2 2026. During the Q1 FY2027 earnings call (revenue $81.6B, +85% YoY), Huang emphasized: 'The world is rebuilding computing for agentic AI and robotic AI. And Nvidia sits at the center of it all.'
main.keep_reason: 베라 CPU(Arm 기반, 88 Olympus 코어, 1.2TB/s 대역폭)의 2000억 달러 TAM과 에이전트 AI 시대 CPU-GPU 역할 분담 — MangoBoost DPU 사업 인접 영역(오케스트레이션/CPU 가속)에 직접 연관.
main.select_reason: NVIDIA Q1과 별도 다룰 가치가 있는 베라 CPU 단독 스토리 — 에이전트 AI 시대의 CPU 오케스트레이션 역할 정립과 2000억 달러 신규 TAM은 MangoBoost DPU/오케스트레이션 영역 직접 인접, products 카테고리 다양성도 보강.

main.title: Memory makers brace for hydrogen fluoride pricing shock as Hormuz blockade impacts supply chain
main.body: A Strait of Hormuz blockade stemming from the US-Iran conflict is disrupting the supply of anhydrous hydrogen fluoride (HF), a critical chemical used in semiconductor etching and cleaning. HF production depends on sulfuric acid derived from sulfur — a byproduct of oil and gas refining now constrained by regional instability. China, the world's largest HF exporter, has restricted exports as sulfuric acid demand surges from fertilizer, steel, and battery industries. Prices for hydrogen fluoride have jumped 'as much as 130% over early-2026 levels,' with South Korean chemical suppliers (Soulbrain, ENF Technology, Foosung) expecting to pass these costs to Samsung and SK Hynix by July 2026. Korean chemical firms began receiving higher-priced HF shipments in mid-May. Sulfuric acid comprises over 50% of HF production costs, making the material particularly vulnerable to refining disruptions. Historical context: A 2019 Japan-South Korea trade dispute restricted HF supplies by 87.9%, yet consumer memory prices remained relatively stable due to inventory buffers. Today's situation differs critically: 'There is no glut of memory chips to buffer material supply concerns. There's a global shortage.' Mitigation: Fluoride Korea's new Ulsan plant (projected Q4 2026 startup, 50,000-ton capacity) could address half of South Korea's demand and provide relief.
main.keep_reason: 호르무즈 봉쇄로 무수불산(HF) 가격 130% 급등, 7월부터 삼성·SK하이닉스 수급 가격 전가 예상 — 메모리 공급망 비용 충격 직격, 글로벌 메모리 부족 상황과 겹쳐 2019년 일본 수출규제보다 심각.
main.select_reason: HF 130% 급등과 7월 메모리 가격 전가 예고는 challenges 카테고리 유일 후보이자 단일-카테고리 편중을 해소 — 2019년 일본 수출규제와의 비교로 현 메모리 부족 환경에서의 임팩트 차별화가 명확.

main.title: AMD Ryzen AI Max PRO 400 'Gorgon Halo' packs up to 192GB of unified memory — refreshed APU for AI systems
main.body: AMD unveiled the Ryzen AI Max PRO 400 family ahead of Computex, featuring a significant memory capacity upgrade. The new chips support up to 192GB of RAM, representing a 50% increase over the previous 300 series' 128GB maximum. Top-tier SKU (Ryzen AI Max+ PRO 495): 16 Zen 5 CPU cores with 5.2GHz boost, RDNA 3.5 integrated GPU (Radeon 8050S, 40 compute units), 55 TOPS NPU, 45-120W TDP range, up to 192GB LPDDR5X memory support. Additional SKUs: Ryzen AI Max PRO 490 (12 cores, 5.0GHz), Ryzen AI Max PRO 485 (8 cores, 5.0GHz). The expanded memory allows systems to allocate as much as 160GB to the GPU, enabling support for larger AI models — enough to load a 300B FP4 parameter model locally. AMD acknowledges that 'this change is not likely to move the needle on performance,' as compute throughput and bandwidth remain unchanged. Systems launching Q3 2026 through ASUS, Lenovo, and HP. AMD is exclusively releasing PRO SKUs with enterprise management features, signaling an AI-focused positioning rather than consumer applications. Development kits with previous-generation Strix Halo chips will be available for pre-order in June starting at $3,999.
main.keep_reason: AMD Ryzen AI Max PRO 400(Zen 5 16코어 + 55 TOPS NPU + 192GB 통합 메모리, 300B FP4 로컬 로딩 가능) — MangoBoost가 핵심 협업 영역인 AMD 생태계 신제품, Computex 직전 발표.
main.select_reason: MangoBoost 핵심 협업 영역인 AMD 생태계 신제품 — 192GB 통합 메모리, 300B FP4 로컬 로딩 가능 등 엔터프라이즈 AI 워크스테이션 포지셔닝의 명확한 신호, Computex 직전 타이밍.

main.title: Alibaba Unveils Zhenwu M890 AI Agent Chip: 3x H20 Performance, 144GB HBM3, NVIDIA Alternative for China
main.body: Alibaba's semiconductor subsidiary T-Head unveiled the Zhenwu M890, a GPU-class AI accelerator delivering three times the performance of its predecessor, the Zhenwu 810E. The processor is purpose-built for AI agent workloads requiring sustained context retention and multi-step autonomous task execution. Key specs: 144GB HBM3 memory (50% increase over 810E's 96GB), 800 GB/s interchip bandwidth. The chip targets NVIDIA's H100 generation — the NVIDIA product Chinese customers can no longer legally purchase under US export controls. The Zhenwu M890 utilizes process nodes that Chinese foundries can manufacture without US-controlled lithography equipment. T-Head has shipped more than 560,000 Zhenwu units to date, with over 400 external customers across 20 industries including automotive and financial services. Multi-year roadmap: V900 (Q3 2027, 3x performance, 216GB, 1,200 GB/s bandwidth), J900 (Q3 2028). Alibaba simultaneously released Qwen 3.7-Max, an LLM engineered for advanced coding and long-running agent tasks, capable of operating continuously for up to 35 hours without performance degradation. Alibaba invested more than 380 billion yuan (~$53 billion) on cloud and AI infrastructure over three years. T-Head is reportedly planning an IPO to fund expanded infrastructure investment. The chip competes directly with Cambricon and Huawei's Ascend for the domestic Chinese accelerator market.
main.keep_reason: Alibaba T-Head Zhenwu M890(144GB HBM3, 800GB/s, NVIDIA H100급) 발표 — 중국향 NVIDIA 대체 가속기 본격화, AI 에이전트 워크로드 특화(35시간 연속 운영 Qwen 3.7-Max) — DPU 인접 가속기 시장 핵심 신호.
main.select_reason: 중국향 NVIDIA H100 대체 가속기의 본격적 등장 — 144GB HBM3·800GB/s·V900/J900 로드맵까지 공개된 multi-year 위협 시그널, DPU 인접 가속기 경쟁 구도에서 MangoBoost가 추적할 핵심 동향.

The CPU is now in production, with partner availability in H2 2026. During the Q1 FY2027 earnings call (revenue $81.6B, +85% YoY), Huang emphasized: 'The world is rebuilding computing for agentic AI and robotic AI. And Nvidia sits at the center of it all.'

competitor_articles.title: Google Cloud TPU Competitor Race: NVIDIA Q1 Beat Fuels Hyperscaler AI Spending Debate
competitor_articles.body: As NVIDIA reported Q1 FY2027 revenue of $81.6 billion — beating expectations by $2.6 billion — the debate over hyperscaler AI spending sustainability intensified. Jensen Huang confirmed hyperscaler capex will hit $1 trillion this year, with long-term potential of $3-4 trillion annually. Data center compute capacity exceeding 10MW more than doubled globally in one year, now surpassing 80 facilities worldwide. Despite the strong results, Google's TPU 8 and Blackstone joint venture ($25B TPU-based cloud) announced earlier this week signal that large customers are developing alternative compute architectures. NVIDIA's Q2 guidance of $91 billion explicitly excludes China datacenter revenue — a potential $3.5-4B annual upside if H200 exports eventually normalize. CFO Colette Kress confirmed Vera Rubin NVL144 first samples shipped to customers this week (June delivery to major North American hyperscalers), with full ramp in Q4 FY2027. Blackwell Ultra transition well underway. NVIDIA maintains >80% market share in AI accelerators globally. Marvell partnership (NVLink Fusion, $2B strategic equity) and new Dell PowerEdge XE9812 for Vera Rubin NVL72 system represent continued ecosystem expansion.

competitor_articles.title: Alibaba Unveils Zhenwu M890 AI Agent Chip: 3x H20 Performance, 144GB HBM3, NVIDIA Alternative for China
competitor_articles.body: Alibaba's semiconductor subsidiary T-Head unveiled the Zhenwu M890, a GPU-class AI accelerator delivering three times the performance of its predecessor, the Zhenwu 810E. The processor is purpose-built for AI agent workloads requiring sustained context retention and multi-step autonomous task execution. Key specs: 144GB HBM3 memory (50% increase over 810E's 96GB), 800 GB/s interchip bandwidth. The chip targets NVIDIA's H100 generation — the NVIDIA product Chinese customers can no longer legally purchase under US export controls. The Zhenwu M890 utilizes process nodes that Chinese foundries can manufacture without US-controlled lithography equipment. T-Head has shipped more than 560,000 Zhenwu units to date, with over 400 external customers across 20 industries including automotive and financial services. Multi-year roadmap: V900 (Q3 2027, 3x performance, 216GB, 1,200 GB/s bandwidth), J900 (Q3 2028). Alibaba simultaneously released Qwen 3.7-Max, an LLM engineered for advanced coding and long-running agent tasks, capable of operating continuously for up to 35 hours without performance degradation. Alibaba invested more than 380 billion yuan (~$53 billion) on cloud and AI infrastructure over three years. T-Head is reportedly planning an IPO to fund expanded infrastructure investment. The chip competes directly with Cambricon and Huawei's Ascend for the domestic Chinese accelerator market.
competitor_articles.keep_reason: Alibaba T-Head Zhenwu M890(144GB HBM3, 800GB/s, NVIDIA H100급) 발표 — 중국향 NVIDIA 대체 가속기 본격화, AI 에이전트 워크로드 특화(35시간 연속 운영 Qwen 3.7-Max) — DPU 인접 가속기 시장 핵심 신호.

competitor_articles.title: Applied Materials와 Broadcom, AI 패키징 혁신 위해 EPIC 플랫폼 파트너십 체결
competitor_articles.body: 어플라이드 머티어리얼즈(Applied Materials)는 브로드컴(Broadcom)이 EPIC(Equipment and Process Innovation for Commercialization) 플랫폼의 혁신 파트너로 참여한다고 발표했다. 양사는 차세대 AI 시스템을 위한 첨단 칩 패키징 기술 연구개발을 협력할 계획이다. EPIC 센터는 실리콘밸리에 건설 중인 50억 달러 규모의 R&D 시설로 삼성전자, SK하이닉스, TSMC, 마이크론 등이 투자했으며 2026년 하반기 개소 예정이다. 이 시설은 '반도체 기업의 연구에서 양산까지 상용화 기간을 획기적으로 단축'하는 것을 목표로 한다. 협력 분야는 하이브리드 본딩과 광학 연동 패키징(CPO) 등 이종 집적·첨단 패키징 기술에 집중된다. 게리 딕커슨 어플라이드 CEO는 'EPIC 플랫폼은 생태계 전반의 협업 혁신을 달성하기 위해 설계됐다'고 강조했다. 찰리 카와스 브로드컴 반도체솔루션 사업부장은 '차세대 AI 시스템 구현을 위해 전체 공급망의 긴밀한 협업이 필수적'이라고 밝혔다.
competitor_articles.keep_reason: Applied Materials EPIC 50억 달러 R&D 센터에 Broadcom이 혁신 파트너로 합류 — 하이브리드 본딩/CPO 등 첨단 AI 칩 패키징 협력, 삼성·SK하이닉스·TSMC·Micron 투자한 생태계 확장.
